tools.name: kernel.receipt
tools.description: Read the receipt of a filing or decision write: operation_id from that write's result. Shows the outcome, the actor and, for an agent's write, the delegation that approved it.

operation_id.description: The operation_id a filing or decision write returned.

tools.name: project.list
tools.description: Find a project by its name: every project with its name and id, newest first. Archived projects only with include_archived. Each project's id is what the other project tools take as project_id.

include_archived.description: Optional. Also list archived projects (default false).

tools.name: project.get
tools.description: Read one project: its name, description, lifecycle and revision.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.get_room
tools.description: See a project room whole: what needs you (needsYou), where it stands (health), its milestones and risks (items), meetings, filed resources, sources, the review, the updates with their deliveries, the steward's latest run and the Room's write receipts.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.create
tools.description: Make a project: a room for one piece of work. Only the name is required. The project's id is in the result (project.id); the other project tools take it as project_id. It watches no source (the Room's face makes a project with GitHub or Jira sources through its Door).

keywords.description: Optional list of words that tie meetings to this project.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.update
tools.description: Change a project's fields (name, description, keywords, purpose, target date ...). Archiving is not a field change: use project.archive.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

patch.description: The fields to change; lifecycle archived is refused.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.archive
tools.description: Archive a project. This also pauses its watches and turns its unattended steward runs off. project.restore brings it back (its watches and unattended runs stay off).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.restore
tools.description: Bring an archived project back to active. Its watches and unattended steward runs stay off.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.link
tools.description: File a meeting in a project room. meeting_id comes from meeting.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

meeting_id.description: The meeting id: meetings[].id from meeting.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.unlink
tools.description: Take a meeting out of a project room. meeting_id comes from meeting.list or project.get_room.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

meeting_id.description: The meeting id: meetings[].id from meeting.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.open_review
tools.description: See what changed in a project since the last review: opens (or returns the one open) review window, with its proposals.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.get_delta
tools.description: Read the open review of a project and its proposals, or that none is open (with the last accepted time).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.decide_proposal
tools.description: Decide one proposal of the open review: accept, edit_accept (with patch), defer (until a date) or dismiss. review_id and proposal_id come from project.get_delta.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

review_id.description: The review id: review_id from project.get_delta, or review_id from project.open_review.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id: proposals[].id from project.get_delta.

patch.description: Optional, for edit_accept: the fields to change.

deferred_until.description: Optional, for defer: an ISO-8601 date.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.accept_review
tools.description: Accept the open review of a project: its decided proposals take effect and the undecided ones are superseded. review_id comes from project.get_delta.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

review_id.description: The review id: review_id from project.get_delta, or review_id from project.open_review.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.list_updates
tools.description: List a project's updates, newest first: drafts, published and superseded. Copy my update for delivery: a published update's body_md is the finished text you deliver yourself. Each update's deliveries list every time you marked it delivered (oldest first).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

lifecycle.description: Optional filter: draft, published or superseded.

tools.name: project.draft_update
tools.description: Draft my update: writes a draft of the project's update from the Room (its milestones, risks, meetings and review). generator deterministic (default) or model. Read it back with project.list_updates.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.update_draft
tools.description: Edit the text of a draft update (body_md). A published update cannot change. update_id comes from project.list_updates.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

body_md.description: The new Markdown text of the draft.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.publish_update
tools.description: Publish my update in the Room: the draft becomes the read-only published update of the project. Nothing leaves HoldSpeak: copy the published body_md (project.list_updates) and deliver it yourself.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.list
tools.description: List a project's milestones, risks, dependencies, signals and workstreams. Optional item_type filter; limit 1 to 1000 (default 200) and offset.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_type.description: Optional filter: milestone, risk, dependency, signal or workstream.

tools.name: project.item.create
tools.description: Add a milestone or a risk to a project (also a dependency, signal or workstream). A milestone takes a due_at date; a risk takes details likelihood and impact. project_id comes from project.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_type.description: milestone, risk, dependency, signal or workstream.

severity.description: Optional: critical, high, medium or low.

owner_ref.description: Optional owner, as kind:id (for example person:<id>).

due_at.description: Optional date, ISO 8601 (for a milestone: when it is due).

lifecycle.description: Optional start state in the type's set; default planned (milestone), open (risk), healthy, active, active.

details.description: Optional, closed per item type (unknown fields are refused): milestone {completion_evidence_refs}; risk {likelihood, impact, mitigation} (likelihood and impact required); dependency {direction: upstream|downstream, counterpart_ref, required_by, confidence}; signal {metric, unit, latest_value, source_ref, observed_at}; workstream {}.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.update
tools.description: Change a milestone's or risk's fields: title, summary, severity, owner, due date, order, details or lifecycle. A milestone is marked reached with project.item.transition, not here. item_id comes from project.item.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_id.description: The item id: items[].id from project.item.list, or item.id from project.item.create.

patch.description: The fields to change; at least one.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.transition
tools.description: Move a milestone or risk to a new state: verb is the target state (a milestone: reached, missed, dropped; a risk: mitigated, accepted, closed ...). Already there: nothing changes. item_id comes from project.item.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_id.description: The item id: items[].id from project.item.list, or item.id from project.item.create.

verb.description: The target state, in the item type's set.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.resource.list
tools.description: List what is filed in a project room (meetings, notes, decisions ... as kind:id references).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.resource.add
tools.description: File a thing in a project room: a meeting, note, decision or other desk object, as kind:id. relationship member (default), source, output or related.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

resource_ref.description: The thing to file, as kind:id -- for example meeting:<id>, note:<id>, decision_record:<id>. Kinds: meeting, transcript, artifact, decision, note, knowledge, zone, project, thread, persona, workflow, sequence, integration, decision_record, desk_decision, action, project_item, workbench, workbench_item, cadence. A GitHub or Jira reference is not a resource: it is a watched source.

relationship.description: Optional: member (default), source, output or related.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.resource.remove
tools.description: Take a filed thing out of a project room. resource_ref comes from project.resource.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

resource_ref.description: The filed reference, as kind:id: resources[].resource_ref from project.resource.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.mark_update_delivered
tools.description: Mark it delivered: record that you delivered a published update yourself (to your boss, then to a peer ...). Each mark is its own record with its time and optional To. HoldSpeak delivers nothing. A mark without command_id is a new record every time; repeat a command_id to retry one mark.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

delivered_to.description: Optional: who you delivered it to, in your words (200 characters at most).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.configure_steward
tools.description: Read or set the steward's policy for a project: what it may do (eligible_effect_kinds), its bounds, and whether it may run on its own (unattended_enabled). Give only project_id to read it.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

enabled.description: Optional. Turn the steward on or off.

unattended_enabled.description: Optional. Let the steward run on a schedule without you.

eligible_effect_kinds.description: Optional. What the steward may do: refresh_sources, create_proposals, apply_proposal_effects, draft_update, create_door_item, github_comment.

evaluation_cadence_minutes.description: Optional, 1 to 10080: how often the project's watches read.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.run_steward
tools.description: Let the steward run on a project now: it reads the sources, opens a review, and does what its policy allows. Returns run_id and operation_id at once; the run works in the background. Read it with project.get_steward_run.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

watermark.description: Optional text to find this run again.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.stop_steward
tools.description: Stop a steward run. The run stops at its next safe point and ends with its own receipt.

run_id.description: The steward run id: run_id from project.run_steward, or steward.latest_run.id from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.get_steward_run
tools.description: Read a steward run: its state, phase, steps, its operation_id and its terminal receipt.

run_id.description: The steward run id: run_id from project.run_steward, or steward.latest_run.id from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.steward.trigger
tools.description: Do the scheduled work now: read the watches that are due and start the steward runs they ask for. Returns operation_id at once; project.get_steward_run reads each run.

tools.name: project.setup.start
tools.description: Start a new durable setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.resume
tools.description: Resume (read) an existing setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.answer
tools.description: Answer an interview question in a setup session.

tools.name: project.setup.suggest
tools.description: Generate watch proposals for a setup session based on answers so far.

tools.name: project.setup.finalize
tools.description: Atomically finalize a setup session: create the project, activate selected+passed proposals as graduated watches, establish baselines. All-or-nothing.

command_id.description: Idempotency key.

tools.name: provider.list
tools.description: List configured providers (native + GitHub) with their capabilities.

tools.name: provider.github_connection
tools.description: Get the GitHub provider connection status.

tools.name: provider.github_discover
tools.description: Bounded discovery of GitHub repositories through the configured adapter.

tools.name: provider.github_validate_repo
tools.description: Validate a GitHub repository by owner/repo string.

tools.name: provider.jira_connections

tools.name: channel.destinations
tools.description: Where can I send? List your saved destinations (a folder, a GitHub issue or pull request, a Jira work item, a Confluence space): each with its name, channel, account, target, badge (local, or cloud), state, and the state of its connection.

include_parked.description: Optional. Also list parked (removed or edited) destinations.

tools.name: channel.save_destination
tools.description: Save a destination you send to: a folder (an absolute path; HoldSpeak writes a new file there per send), a GitHub issue or pull request (a comment per send; the gh login is saved with it), one Jira work item (a comment per send), a Confluence space (a blog post per send), or email through a provider (SendGrid): your verified sender, the name of the saved key, and the To and Cc addresses. Mark a folder synced if a cloud client syncs it. Give replaces to edit one: the old destination is parked and this one is new.

name.description: Your name for it (120 characters at most).

channel.description: The channel: file (a folder), github, jira, confluence or email.

synced.description: Optional, file: a cloud client syncs this folder (the badge says cloud).

host.description: github: the host (github.com if not given).

kind.description: github: issue or pr (a pull request).

number.description: github: the issue or pull request number.

email.description: jira, confluence: the email of the acli account.

key.description: jira: ONE work item key, like ABC-123.

provider.description: email: the provider (sendgrid if not given).

from_email.description: email: the sender address (a sender the provider verified).

key_ref.description: email: the name of the key saved with channel.save_email_key (the provider's name if not given). Never the key.

to.description: email: the To addresses (at least one).

cc.description: email: the Cc addresses (To and Cc together: 20 at most).

replaces.description: Optional. Edit: the destination id this one replaces (it is parked).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.remove_destination
tools.description: Remove a saved destination: it is parked, its history is kept, and a send prepared to it is refused.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.check_destination
tools.description: Check a saved destination: a folder still resolves to the saved path, exists and is writable; a GitHub, Jira or Confluence destination shows the stored state of its connection; an email destination's key is in the OS keychain, then its sender's verification as the provider last answered a send from it (no call to the provider).

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

tools.name: channel.preview
tools.description: See exactly what a destination would get for a published update: the readable preview, the size and the digest of the exact bytes. Nothing is sent. Pass the digest to channel.send.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

tools.name: channel.prepare
tools.description: Prepare a send of a published update to a saved destination: "send the update to <destination>". It freezes the destination and the exact bytes (its preview) in a prepared send that waits for the owner. Nothing leaves the machine; only the owner sends it (or discards it).

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.discard
tools.description: Discard a prepared send: it will never be sent. The owner's; against a Send at the same time, one wins.

send_id.description: The prepared send: send.id from channel.prepare, or sends[].id from channel.sends.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.send
tools.description: The owner's Send: send a prepared send (send_id), or send a published update to a saved destination with the digest of the preview he saw (update_id, destination_id, preview_digest). The answer is the channel's proof (a folder: the file's path, sha256 and size, read back; GitHub: the comment URL; Jira and Confluence: the id acli gives; email: the provider's message id, ACCEPTED BY SENDGRID -- accepted for processing, not delivered), a known failure with its code, or unknown. HoldSpeak never sends again by itself: a repeat of the same command_id answers the first result. Only the owner sends; an agent prepares.

send_id.description: The prepared send: send.id from channel.prepare.

update_id.description: Inline form: the published update (updates[].id from project.list_updates).

destination_id.description: Inline form: the saved destination (destinations[].id).

preview_digest.description: Inline form: payload_digest from channel.preview (what he saw).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.sends
tools.description: What was sent: the sends of a published update (or one send, or the latest), each with its destination, state (prepared, dispatching, sent, failed, unknown, discarded), proof or reason, and the preview of its frozen bytes.

update_id.description: Optional: one update's sends.

tools.name: kernel.receipt
tools.description: Read the receipt of a filing or decision write: operation_id from that write's result. Shows the outcome, the actor and, for an agent's write, the delegation that approved it.

operation_id.description: The operation_id a filing or decision write returned.

tools.name: project.list
tools.description: Find a project by its name: every project with its name and id, newest first. Archived projects only with include_archived. Each project's id is what the other project tools take as project_id.

include_archived.description: Optional. Also list archived projects (default false).

tools.name: project.get
tools.description: Read one project: its name, description, lifecycle and revision.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.get_room
tools.description: See a project room whole: what needs you (needsYou), where it stands (health), its milestones and risks (items), meetings, filed resources, sources, the review, the updates with their deliveries, the steward's latest run and the Room's write receipts.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.create
tools.description: Make a project: a room for one piece of work. Only the name is required. The project's id is in the result (project.id); the other project tools take it as project_id. It watches no source (the Room's face makes a project with GitHub or Jira sources through its Door).

keywords.description: Optional list of words that tie meetings to this project.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.update
tools.description: Change a project's fields (name, description, keywords, purpose, target date ...). Archiving is not a field change: use project.archive.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

patch.description: The fields to change; lifecycle archived is refused.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.archive
tools.description: Archive a project. This also pauses its watches and turns its unattended steward runs off. project.restore brings it back (its watches and unattended runs stay off).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.restore
tools.description: Bring an archived project back to active. Its watches and unattended steward runs stay off.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.link
tools.description: File a meeting in a project room. meeting_id comes from meeting.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

meeting_id.description: The meeting id: meetings[].id from meeting.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.unlink
tools.description: Take a meeting out of a project room. meeting_id comes from meeting.list or project.get_room.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

meeting_id.description: The meeting id: meetings[].id from meeting.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.open_review
tools.description: See what changed in a project since the last review: opens (or returns the one open) review window, with its proposals.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.get_delta
tools.description: Read the open review of a project and its proposals, or that none is open (with the last accepted time).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.decide_proposal
tools.description: Decide one proposal of the open review: accept, edit_accept (with patch), defer (until a date) or dismiss. review_id and proposal_id come from project.get_delta.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

review_id.description: The review id: review_id from project.get_delta, or review_id from project.open_review.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id: proposals[].id from project.get_delta.

patch.description: Optional, for edit_accept: the fields to change.

deferred_until.description: Optional, for defer: an ISO-8601 date.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.accept_review
tools.description: Accept the open review of a project: its decided proposals take effect and the undecided ones are superseded. review_id comes from project.get_delta.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

review_id.description: The review id: review_id from project.get_delta, or review_id from project.open_review.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.list_updates
tools.description: List a project's updates, newest first: drafts, published and superseded. Copy my update for delivery: a published update's body_md is the finished text you deliver yourself. Each update's deliveries list every time you marked it delivered (oldest first).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

lifecycle.description: Optional filter: draft, published or superseded.

tools.name: project.draft_update
tools.description: Draft my update: writes a draft of the project's update from the Room (its milestones, risks, meetings and review). generator deterministic (default) or model. Read it back with project.list_updates.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.update_draft
tools.description: Edit the text of a draft update (body_md). A published update cannot change. update_id comes from project.list_updates.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

body_md.description: The new Markdown text of the draft.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.publish_update
tools.description: Publish my update in the Room: the draft becomes the read-only published update of the project. Nothing leaves HoldSpeak: copy the published body_md (project.list_updates) and deliver it yourself.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.list
tools.description: List a project's milestones, risks, dependencies, signals and workstreams. Optional item_type filter; limit 1 to 1000 (default 200) and offset.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_type.description: Optional filter: milestone, risk, dependency, signal or workstream.

tools.name: project.item.create
tools.description: Add a milestone or a risk to a project (also a dependency, signal or workstream). A milestone takes a due_at date; a risk takes details likelihood and impact. project_id comes from project.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_type.description: milestone, risk, dependency, signal or workstream.

severity.description: Optional: critical, high, medium or low.

owner_ref.description: Optional owner, as kind:id (for example person:<id>).

due_at.description: Optional date, ISO 8601 (for a milestone: when it is due).

lifecycle.description: Optional start state in the type's set; default planned (milestone), open (risk), healthy, active, active.

details.description: Optional, closed per item type (unknown fields are refused): milestone {completion_evidence_refs}; risk {likelihood, impact, mitigation} (likelihood and impact required); dependency {direction: upstream|downstream, counterpart_ref, required_by, confidence}; signal {metric, unit, latest_value, source_ref, observed_at}; workstream {}.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.update
tools.description: Change a milestone's or risk's fields: title, summary, severity, owner, due date, order, details or lifecycle. A milestone is marked reached with project.item.transition, not here. item_id comes from project.item.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_id.description: The item id: items[].id from project.item.list, or item.id from project.item.create.

patch.description: The fields to change; at least one.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.item.transition
tools.description: Move a milestone or risk to a new state: verb is the target state (a milestone: reached, missed, dropped; a risk: mitigated, accepted, closed ...). Already there: nothing changes. item_id comes from project.item.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

item_id.description: The item id: items[].id from project.item.list, or item.id from project.item.create.

verb.description: The target state, in the item type's set.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.resource.list
tools.description: List what is filed in a project room (meetings, notes, decisions ... as kind:id references).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.resource.add
tools.description: File a thing in a project room: a meeting, note, decision or other desk object, as kind:id. relationship member (default), source, output or related.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

resource_ref.description: The thing to file, as kind:id -- for example meeting:<id>, note:<id>, decision_record:<id>. Kinds: meeting, transcript, artifact, decision, note, knowledge, zone, project, thread, persona, workflow, sequence, integration, decision_record, desk_decision, action, project_item, workbench, workbench_item, cadence. A GitHub or Jira reference is not a resource: it is a watched source.

relationship.description: Optional: member (default), source, output or related.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.resource.remove
tools.description: Take a filed thing out of a project room. resource_ref comes from project.resource.list.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

resource_ref.description: The filed reference, as kind:id: resources[].resource_ref from project.resource.list.

expected_revision.description: Optional. The project revision from your last read (project.get or project.get_room, field revision). When the current revision differs, the call is refused with stale_revision and nothing changes.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.mark_update_delivered
tools.description: Mark it delivered: record that you delivered a published update yourself (to your boss, then to a peer ...). Each mark is its own record with its time and optional To. HoldSpeak delivers nothing. A mark without command_id is a new record every time; repeat a command_id to retry one mark.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

delivered_to.description: Optional: who you delivered it to, in your words (200 characters at most).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.configure_steward
tools.description: Read or set the steward's policy for a project: what it may do (eligible_effect_kinds), its bounds, and whether it may run on its own (unattended_enabled). Give only project_id to read it.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

enabled.description: Optional. Turn the steward on or off.

unattended_enabled.description: Optional. Let the steward run on a schedule without you.

eligible_effect_kinds.description: Optional. What the steward may do: refresh_sources, create_proposals, apply_proposal_effects, draft_update, create_door_item, github_comment.

evaluation_cadence_minutes.description: Optional, 1 to 10080: how often the project's watches read.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: project.run_steward

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

watermark.description: Optional text to find this run again.

run_id.description: The steward run id: run_id from project.run_steward, or steward.latest_run.id from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.get_steward_run
tools.description: Read a steward run: its state, phase, steps, its operation_id and its terminal receipt.

run_id.description: The steward run id: run_id from project.run_steward, or steward.latest_run.id from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.steward.trigger
tools.description: Do the scheduled work now: read the watches that are due and start the steward runs they ask for. Returns operation_id at once; project.get_steward_run reads each run.

tools.name: project.setup.start
tools.description: Start a new durable setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.resume
tools.description: Resume (read) an existing setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.answer
tools.description: Answer an interview question in a setup session.

tools.name: project.setup.suggest
tools.description: Generate watch proposals for a setup session based on answers so far.

tools.name: project.setup.finalize
tools.description: Atomically finalize a setup session: create the project, activate selected+passed proposals as graduated watches, establish baselines. All-or-nothing.

command_id.description: Idempotency key.

tools.name: provider.list
tools.description: List configured providers (native + GitHub) with their capabilities.

tools.name: provider.github_connection
tools.description: Get the GitHub provider connection status.

tools.name: provider.github_discover
tools.description: Bounded discovery of GitHub repositories through the configured adapter.

tools.name: provider.github_validate_repo
tools.description: Validate a GitHub repository by owner/repo string.

tools.name: provider.jira_connections
tools.description: List all Jira connections (site+email pairs) and their status.

tools.name: provider.jira_add_connection
tools.description: Add a Jira connection by site and email (no credentials stored).

tools.name: provider.jira_connection
tools.description: Recheck one Jira connection status (switch + auth status probe).

tools.name: provider.jira_discover
tools.description: Discover Jira resources (projects, issue types, statuses) for a connection.

query.description: Filter text (substring match on key/name for projects).

project_key.description: Project key (required for issue_types and statuses).

tools.name: provider.jira_search
tools.description: Search Jira issues by JQL query.

enrich.description: Enrich each item with duedate, resolution, etc. via workitem view.

tools.name: provider.jira_validate_scope
tools.description: Validate a Jira project key (the validate_repo twin).

tools.name: provider.confluence_connections
tools.description: List all Confluence connections (site+email pairs) and their status.

tools.name: provider.confluence_discover
tools.description: Discover Confluence spaces for a connection.

tools.name: provider.confluence_validate_space
tools.description: Validate a Confluence space key.

tools.name: project.setup.clarify_jira_scope
tools.description: Clarify the Jira scope for a Jira proposal in a setup session.

tools.name: project.watch.inspect
tools.description: Read one watch of a project: its query, rules, state and last reads.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.test
tools.description: Test a watch: one bounded read of its source (GitHub, Jira or Confluence) that changes nothing.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.evaluate
tools.description: Read a watch's source now and record what changed since its last read.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.set_rules
tools.description: Set what a watch does when its source changes (its rules), and optionally how often it reads.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.pause
tools.description: Pause a watch: it stops reading its source.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.resume
tools.description: Resume a paused watch: it reads its source on its schedule again.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.watch.retire
tools.description: Retire a watch: it stops for good and keeps its history.

watch_id.description: The watch id: sources.items[].watchIds[] from project.get_room.

tools.name: project.suggested_sources
tools.description: List the sources a project's meetings mention that the Room does not watch yet (GitHub owner/repo, Jira PROJ-123).

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

tools.name: project.add_suggested_source
tools.description: Watch a suggested source in the Room: it files the source in the Room and arms a watch that reads it on a schedule. When it cannot, it says why and the suggestion stays pending.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

reference.description: The suggested source: suggestions[].reference from project.suggested_sources (owner/repo or PROJ-123).

tools.name: project.dismiss_suggested_source
tools.description: Dismiss a suggested source: the Room does not suggest it again.

project_id.description: The project id: projects[].id from project.list, or project.id from project.create.

reference.description: The suggested source: suggestions[].reference from project.suggested_sources (owner/repo or PROJ-123).

tools.name: connection.list
tools.description: See your connections: GitHub, Jira and Confluence as last checked (each with its own check time, or never_checked), and Calendar and Models as they are now. It checks nothing.

tools.name: connection.recheck
tools.description: Check a connection again now: github, jira or confluence asks the provider and stores what it says; calendar and models read local state.

provider_id.description: github, jira, confluence, calendar or models: tools[].provider_id from connection.list.

ref.description: Optional, Jira or Confluence: one connection (site|email): connections[].connection_ref from connection.list.

tools.name: project.setup.select_proposal
tools.description: Select an existing setup proposal before testing/finalizing it; creates no Watch yet.

tools.name: project.setup.deselect_proposal
tools.description: Deselect a setup proposal before finalization.

tools.name: project.setup.test_proposal
tools.description: Run the actual bounded source test for a setup proposal, recording its result before activation.

tools.name: project.setup.clarify_repo_scope
tools.description: Discover or validate a GitHub repository for an existing setup proposal; omitted repo discovers authorized repositories.

tools.name: channel.destinations
tools.description: Where can I send? List your saved destinations (a folder, a GitHub issue or pull request, a Jira work item, a Confluence space): each with its name, channel, account, target, badge (local, or cloud), state, and the state of its connection.

include_parked.description: Optional. Also list parked (removed or edited) destinations.

tools.name: channel.save_destination
tools.description: Save a destination you send to: a folder (an absolute path; HoldSpeak writes a new file there per send), a GitHub issue or pull request (a comment per send; the gh login is saved with it), one Jira work item (a comment per send), a Confluence space (a blog post per send), or email through a provider (SendGrid): your verified sender, the name of the saved key, and the To and Cc addresses. Mark a folder synced if a cloud client syncs it. Give replaces to edit one: the old destination is parked and this one is new.

name.description: Your name for it (120 characters at most).

channel.description: The channel: file (a folder), github, jira, confluence or email.

synced.description: Optional, file: a cloud client syncs this folder (the badge says cloud).

host.description: github: the host (github.com if not given).

kind.description: github: issue or pr (a pull request).

number.description: github: the issue or pull request number.

email.description: jira, confluence: the email of the acli account.

key.description: jira: ONE work item key, like ABC-123.

provider.description: email: the provider (sendgrid if not given).

from_email.description: email: the sender address (a sender the provider verified).

key_ref.description: email: the name of the key saved with channel.save_email_key (the provider's name if not given). Never the key.

to.description: email: the To addresses (at least one).

cc.description: email: the Cc addresses (To and Cc together: 20 at most).

replaces.description: Optional. Edit: the destination id this one replaces (it is parked).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.remove_destination
tools.description: Remove a saved destination: it is parked, its history is kept, and a send prepared to it is refused.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.check_destination
tools.description: Check a saved destination: a folder still resolves to the saved path, exists and is writable; a GitHub, Jira or Confluence destination shows the stored state of its connection; an email destination's key is in the OS keychain, then its sender's verification as the provider last answered a send from it (no call to the provider).

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

tools.name: channel.preview
tools.description: See exactly what a destination would get for a published update: the readable preview, the size and the digest of the exact bytes. Nothing is sent. Pass the digest to channel.send.

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

tools.name: channel.prepare
tools.description: Prepare a send of a published update to a saved destination: "send the update to <destination>". It freezes the destination and the exact bytes (its preview) in a prepared send that waits for the owner. Nothing leaves the machine; only the owner sends it (or discards it).

update_id.description: The update id: updates[].id from project.list_updates, or update.id from project.draft_update.

destination_id.description: The saved destination: destinations[].id from channel.destinations.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.discard
tools.description: Discard a prepared send: it will never be sent. The owner's; against a Send at the same time, one wins.

send_id.description: The prepared send: send.id from channel.prepare, or sends[].id from channel.sends.

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.send
tools.description: The owner's Send: send a prepared send (send_id), or send a published update to a saved destination with the digest of the preview he saw (update_id, destination_id, preview_digest). The answer is the channel's proof (a folder: the file's path, sha256 and size, read back; GitHub: the comment URL; Jira and Confluence: the id acli gives; email: the provider's message id, ACCEPTED BY SENDGRID -- accepted for processing, not delivered), a known failure with its code, or unknown. HoldSpeak never sends again by itself: a repeat of the same command_id answers the first result. Only the owner sends; an agent prepares.

send_id.description: The prepared send: send.id from channel.prepare.

update_id.description: Inline form: the published update (updates[].id from project.list_updates).

destination_id.description: Inline form: the saved destination (destinations[].id).

preview_digest.description: Inline form: payload_digest from channel.preview (what he saw).

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: channel.sends
tools.description: What was sent: the sends of a published update (or one send, or the latest), each with its destination, state (prepared, dispatching, sent, failed, unknown, discarded), proof or reason, and the preview of its frozen bytes.

update_id.description: Optional: one update's sends.
